Synthetic, analyst-specified biochemical ODE model; not a published paper.
Time t is in minutes. States are dimensionless abstract activities. The fixed compartment has size 1 dimensionless.
Initial R = 0.2.
Initial P = 0.1.
Parameter s = 1.0.
Parameter K = 1.0.
Parameter dr = 0.4.
Parameter kp = 0.7.
Parameter dp = 0.3.
The source contains two equally authoritative alternatives: dR/dt = s/(1+(P/K)**2)-dr*R OR dR/dt = s/(1+(P/K))-dr*R. It does not specify which was used.
Equation dP/dt = kp*R-dp*P.

Author clarification (supersedes the unresolved statement above):
The author confirms dR/dt = s/(1+(P/K)**2)-dr*R. The exponent-one alternative is rejected.
